name: microsoft-powerpoint
description: Use when reading, editing, building, rendering or cleaning PowerPoint decks (.pptx, .pptm, .potx, .ppt, .odp): text across runs, slide delete/reorder/hide, template placeholders, notes, charts, PDF or PNG previews, VBA, Office.js or Graph, and checking untrusted or outgoing decks. Not for Google Slides or Keynote.

platforms.inspect, replace, sanitize, slides: any OS with Python 3.9+ and lxml>=5 (tested on Linux only)
platforms.pptx_build.py: any OS with python-pptx (tested on Linux only)
platforms.pptx_render.py: Linux only (bubblewrap); refuses elsewhere by design

documented_not_executed: references/automation.md (Office.js names checked against @types/office-js 1.0.611; Graph and VBA against Microsoft Learn; no live PowerPoint or tenant run)
